description: Add the animated on-the-wire message viewer to Agora Studio: messages flowing between services animated along the topology-graph edges (61) in real time, with payload inspection. It reads from the console's KCS telemetry reader (`console/src/kcs/spans.ts`) — the same span/telemetry surface the conformance console consumes — rather than inventing a new observability plane; it depends on `55-kcs-observability-rewrite` (Phase D) so it is built on the reader's ratified emitted-telemetry shape, never on the provisional `ObservedSpan` shape Phase D replaces; Studio remains an observer that never sees relayed traffic (it reads emitted telemetry/spans, ADR-0001). Scope: the `studio/` workspace only, reading `console/`'s span reader by reference. agora gates on `make check`.

userStories.title: Map telemetry spans onto graph edges
userStories.description: Read messages from the console's KCS telemetry reader (`spans.ts`) and map each to the topology-graph edge it traversed, so the viewer is driven by real emitted telemetry.
acceptanceCriteria: The viewer sources messages from the console's KCS telemetry reader (`console/src/kcs/spans.ts`), reused by reference — Studio adds no second telemetry plane — and maps each span/message to the source→target edge of the 61 graph

A test feeds a synthetic span set and asserts each message resolves to the correct edge, and that a span between two undiscovered/unmapped participants is dropped or flagged rather than drawn on a nonexistent edge
`make check` green (`npm run lint` + `npm run typecheck` + `vitest` for `studio/`)

userStories.title: Animate messages along edges in real time
userStories.description: Animate each message travelling along its edge as it arrives, so the graph shows live on-the-wire flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages animate along their mapped edges in real time as telemetry arrives (a message appears, travels source→target, and clears), keeping up with an incremental span stream rather than only a static batch

A test asserts the animation state is driven by the span stream (a new span produces an in-flight message on the right edge; edges with no traffic stay idle) using a deterministic clock/test double — no real network
`make check` green; the viewer remains observer-only (reads telemetry, relays nothing)

userStories.title: Payload inspection for a selected message
userStories.description: Let a user select an animated (or recent) message and inspect its payload, so the flow view is also a debugging surface.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a message opens a payload inspector showing its contents/metadata as read from the span (direction, transport MCP/A2A, timing, payload), with no payload fabricated beyond what telemetry carries

A rendering test (`*.test.tsx`) asserts selecting a message shows its payload and that the inspector is empty when nothing is selected / no telemetry is present (consistent with the 60 empty backbone)
